about_the_game:
Cursed Scroll Zine, Vol. 4: River of Night for Shadowdark RPG


Savage cries echo through the choking rainforest as the Black River winds past the ruins of a fallen empire, where explorers hunt for secrets and ancient horrors lurk in obsidian temples, waiting for the sun to die!

The fourth issue of Cursed Scroll Zine adds the formidable Tal-Yool Jungle to your TTRPG game world! Inside, you'll find:
  • Two new classes for Shadowdark RPG: ranger and basilisk warrior
  • A complete druid spell list
  • A double-sized hex crawl
  • Nine mini-adventures linked to the secrets scattered throughout the region
  • High-level adventuring content
  • 18 new monsters, including basilisk cultists and the Jaguar King, a regal man with the head of a black jaguar
  • Classic, hand-drawn GM and player maps for the jungle and all nine mini-adventures

Adapted for Fantasy Grounds by: Kevin Heffernan

Requires: An active subscription or a one time purchase of a Fantasy Grounds license and the Shadowdark RPG ruleset.

Screenshots may differ from what you see in-game based on the extension and ruleset you have loaded.
